description: Shows how the mid-market exchange rate from US dollars to another currency has moved over the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or a year. Mid-market is the rate before any fees, so it is not the rate a payment is priced at, and a past series is no forecast. Use it when someone asks how a currency has moved against the dollar.
name: get_rate_history
title: Rate history
